speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: asked	the Minister for Health for each year in the past three years what is the Assisted Reproductive Technology success rate for public and private centres respectively for couples (i) under 30 years old; (ii) between 30 years old and 35 years old; (iii) between 36 years old and 40 years old; and (iv) above 40 years old.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Can I check with the Senior Minister of State if MOH is going to review the subsidies for ART treatments?

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: Not just the subsidies, but also, is it possible to increase the number of cycles, at least for those between 36 and 40?

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: I note the success rate does drop but I think the trend is that people are having children much later now.

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: I think when we review the age at which we capped the ART co-funding, really it is based on evidence.
